name: Five Chariots
source: Sancai Tuhui (1609), Qiyong (implements) chapters 5-6, plate '下澤車 (marsh cart)'; National Diet Library copy 三才圖會 106卷 [14], frame 68
treatment: genuine cut-out: a two-wheeled cart with a slatted bed, a rack and a long curved pole
fit: placed over the group: centred on its stars, upright, 14 deg on its larger side; no star tied
subject: 五車, the Five Chariots: one of the encyclopaedia's carts
honesty: The pole's small carved end, drawn as loose flecks in the print, is left out; the pole ends at its two rails.
subject_role_note: a cart: the group's chariots (車), one cart shown for the five
